user.title: Set up KEMS
user.description: KEMS will scan Home Assistant for compatible Octopus electricity and gas, Ohme, and FoxESS Modbus entities. KEMS remains read-only.

confirm.title: Set up KEMS automatically

data_description.review_entities: Open the full mapping screen before KEMS is created.

entities.title: Review KEMS source entities
entities.description: Choose the entities KEMS observes. Only the current electricity import rate is required. Gas, Ohme, and FoxESS Modbus can be added later through Reconfigure.

data_description.current_export_rate: Octopus Export current price. KEMS falls back to 12p/kWh when this is absent.
data_description.electricity_standing_charge: Octopus electricity standing charge, used in whole-home cost totals.
data_description.off_peak: Octopus binary sensor that is on during the normal Intelligent Go cheap period.
data_description.intelligent_slot: Octopus binary sensor for an active Intelligent dispatch slot.
data_description.next_offpeak_start: Octopus timestamp for the next cheap-period start.
data_description.offpeak_end: Octopus timestamp for the current or next cheap-period end.
data_description.gas_current_rate: Octopus gas unit rate in p/kWh or GBP/kWh.
data_description.gas_standing_charge: Octopus gas standing charge in p/day or GBP/day.
data_description.gas_meter_total: Cumulative gas meter in kWh or m³. KEMS converts m³ using the options conversion factor.
data_description.gas_usage_today: Octopus current accumulated gas consumption for today.
data_description.gas_cost_today: Octopus current accumulated gas cost for today.
data_description.ev_status: Ohme charger status sensor; KEMS derives connected and charging states from it.
data_description.ev_connected: Optional legacy/custom Ohme connected binary sensor.
data_description.ev_charging: Optional legacy/custom Ohme charging binary sensor.
data_description.ev_soc: Ohme vehicle state of charge percentage.
data_description.battery_soc: FoxESS Modbus battery state of charge percentage.
data_description.battery_voltage: FoxESS Battery Voltage, used with Battery Current to derive power.
data_description.battery_current: FoxESS Battery Current, used with Battery Voltage to derive power.
data_description.grid_import_kw: FoxESS Modbus power currently imported from the grid.
data_description.grid_export_kw: FoxESS Modbus power currently exported to the grid.

init.title: KEMS proposal, gas, ROI, and lifetime settings
init.description: These settings affect read-only analysis, simulation, ROI, and the permanent lifetime ledger. KEMS never writes to Octopus, Ohme, or FoxESS Modbus.

data.proposal_solar_enabled: Use proposal solar model when live PV is unavailable

data_description.scan_interval_seconds: KEMS reads Home Assistant state only; minimum 30 seconds.
data_description.history_days: KEMS stores compact observations locally in Home Assistant storage.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Defaults to the quoted 56.42kWh FoxESS battery storage.
data_description.battery_reserve_percent: Defaults to 10%, matching the proposal's 50.77kWh usable capacity.
data_description.battery_initial_percent: Used when no real FoxESS battery SOC is available.
data_description.max_charge_kw: Defaults to the quoted FoxESS KH10 10kW inverter limit.
data_description.max_discharge_kw: Defaults to the quoted FoxESS KH10 10kW inverter limit.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Simulation assumption; the proposal does not guarantee conversion efficiency.
data_description.discharge_efficiency: Simulation assumption; the proposal does not guarantee conversion efficiency.
data_description.export_rate_pence: Defaults to Octopus Export at 12p/kWh all day.
data_description.export_limit_kw: Simulation-only assumption. Confirm the final DNO-approved export limit before Control is added.
data_description.battery_export_enabled: Outside cheap periods, preserve forecast house demand and simulate exporting remaining battery energy toward the 10% reserve.
data_description.proposal_solar_enabled: Models 21 x 460W panels, 9.66kWp, three roof orientations, and the proposal monthly generation baseline.
data_description.proposal_solar_factor: Scale the proposal baseline for cloud/weather sensitivity; 1.0 uses the proposal average.
data_description.gas_kwh_per_m3: Used only when the configured gas source reports cubic metres rather than kWh.
data_description.simulation_strategy: Export first follows Kyle's Intelligent Go plus 12p export plan; self-use supplies the home from solar first.
data_description.battery_power_positive_is_discharge: Controls how KEMS separates FoxESS battery charge and discharge totals. Leave enabled when positive power means battery discharge.
data_description.system_cost_gbp: Defaults to the quoted system price of £20,995.
data_description.additional_costs_gbp: Add DNO fees, structural work, smart-meter work, or later installation additions.
data_description.grants_rebates_gbp: Deduct grants, rebates, or discounts from the investment KEMS must recover.
data_description.commissioning_date: Leave blank before installation. Set this once the system is commissioned to begin actual ROI and payback tracking.
data_description.annual_maintenance_gbp: KEMS accrues this allowance daily after commissioning.
data_description.manual_system_costs_gbp: All-time repair, servicing, or replacement expenditure already incurred. Update the total when new costs occur.
data_description.electricity_inflation_percent: Used only in future ROI projections. KEMS still uses actual Octopus rates for current simulations.
data_description.battery_degradation_percent: Reduces projected future annual value over time.
data_description.discount_rate_percent: Used to calculate discounted net value. The proposal benchmark used 6.75%.
data_description.roi_forecast_years: Number of years included in the predicted net-value calculation.
